item: A re-index removes the date tags nobody judged that the text no longer yields (R697 follow-up)
summary: The date store only ever added tags, so a date the pooled re-index once read under an English guess (03/04/2024 as 4 March in an untagged article) stayed for good. A re-extraction now removes this extractor's unjudged candidate tags it no longer finds and relabels the ones it finds again; confirmed, rejected and other extractors' tags are never touched. Old rows converge only after a re-index.
